_doc: THE ONLY FILE YOU NEED TO EDIT. Run: python3 run.py   (or: python3 run.py --dry-run )

run._doc: run_id 'auto' = timestamped identifier. resume=true restarts an interrupted run without regenerating what is already done.

llm._doc: backend: opencode | http_api | dry_run. 'command' is the exact command template: {prompt} is replaced by the prompt, as a single argument. Authentication is handled by opencode (opencode auth login); never put a key here, settings.json is archived into out/<run_id>/settings.snapshot.json. Model id: opencode models.
llm.extra_args_note: Add flags (temperature, seed) directly to 'command' if your CLI supports them.

generation._doc: languages: en | fr | de | it. style: free | structured | random. The CAD-RADS label is NOT configurable here: it is computed by src/classify.py from the lesions, then imposed in the prompt. cadrads_distribution and lesion_mode control the corpus shape.
generation._distribution_doc: auto = epidemiology-like weights below; uniform = same share for every category listed in cadrads_weights (200 each is got with uniform + a multiple of the number of categories); manual = the weights below, normalised, so percentages work (they need not sum to 100).
generation._lesion_mode_doc: mono = exactly one lesion per patient; multi = 1 to 3 lesions, always on different coronary arteries.

other_structures._doc: describe_normal: describe the normal structures of the field of view (lungs, pleura, mediastinum, aorta, pericardium) — changes the SHAPE of the report. include_incidental: add MINOR incidental findings at their approximate prevalence (catalogue: reference/incidental_findings.json) — changes the CONTENT. prevalence_scale multiplies every prevalence (1.0 = catalogue values).

checks._doc: Automatic checks. label_integrity: does the report contain the computed label (integrity, not accuracy). modifier_mention: are the stent / graft / non-diagnostic segment described in the body. 'fail' = report excluded, 'warn' = kept with a flag.

export._doc: Filename of the .txt files in reports/. Placeholders: {case_id} {cadrads} {lang} {style}. write_xlsx writes dataset.xlsx, one row per report with every input field of the scenario.
